messages.subject: Updating the "Omnicomplete"
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I was wondering how nvim figures out how to suggest things for omnicomplete of R functions. I have a project specific R package and I've been updating (i.e. adding new functions) and "re-installing" each time I updated it using:

devtools::install("projectutils")

When I load it, the new functions are available but omnicomplete doesn't seem to autocomplete new functions. Instead, it only sees the old functions and additionally no syntax highlighting is provided for the new functions. It seems the actually place for nvim-r-plugin to look for omnifunction completion is not updated?

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: Updating the "Omnicomplete"
messages.body_plain: The nvimcom package checks the version number of loaded packages. If the version number does not change, it does not update the lists of functions for omnicompletion and syntax highlight (which are stored at ~/.cache/Nvim-R/). The updating is is done when the number of loaded packages changes.
